items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: And we came up together... Ann Buell, sweet... She lived right out there on La Perru Street... she's a few months younger than I am.

ctx.x: A little bit, but not enough. Not much about Bab Frank.
Well, I knew him personally. I don't know too much about his band, but he's daughter, maybe, but that's Ann Buell's daddy, you know. Bad Frank.
And what is her name now?
